summary: Iteration 33 (frontend only): tested HSN/SAC search (HsnInput) in Contracts, Change Orders, BOQ, Work Order and Vendor Bill, and the RA Bill print header. Logged in as SuperAdmin. Working: (1) Search. 'cement' gives 2523 and 3816; 'steel' gives 995445, 7213, 7214, 7216, 7306, 7308, 7217; '9954' gives SAC 9954xx; 'tmt' gives 7213; 'paint' gives 995473, 3208, 3209; 'sand' gives 2505; 'zzzz' shows no list and keeps the free text. Options show code, description and 'HSN/SAC · GST%'. (2) Contracts. Picking an option sets code + gstPct, and fills the description only when it is empty (an existing description is kept). Codes 2523/995444 persist after save and re-open. In view mode (fieldset disabled) the dropdown does not open. (3) Change Orders. Picking 7216 sets hsn and changes gstPct from 12 to 18. After Save → Submit → Approve, the extra contract item has code 7216 ('[Extra] TEST extra steel'), and co-hsn is disabled after approval. (4) RA bill generated from approved MB shows the code prefix on lines. Totals: basic 13,300, GST 2,394, retention 665, TDS 266, net 14,763. ra-print-btn appears only after save. The print popup shows the company name, tagline, pill line, address, Mob/Email/website, State, client and GSTIN, Contract, Project, Client WO 'WO/CLIENT/77', WO Type 'Service / Works Contract', a HSN/SAC column (2523/995444/7216), colspan=9 on all 7 totals rows (header has 10 cols, correct), amount in words, and 4 signature blocks incl. 'For M/s ARUN ENTERPRISES / Authorised Signatory'. With a logo and company GST/PAN/bank set in localStorage, the logo image loads, 'GSTIN · PAN · State' shows, and the 'Payment to: … Bank · A/c · IFSC' line shows. (5) BOQ. boq-hsn-0 pick 7213 auto-filled the description; boq-hsn-1 kept the existing description. Saved BOQ in Mongo has items.hsn ['7213','995473'], and it reloads via search. (6) WO. Choosing that BOQ in wo-boqref copied hsn to wo-hsn-0/1. wo-hsn-2 pick 2523 set hsn + description. WO save was NOT verified because the DB has 0 vendors ('Select Vendor' list is empty). (7) Vendor bill. item-hsn-0 pick 2505 sets the value. Bill save was NOT verified: 'Fetch approved vendor first' because there are 0 vendors. (8) Dropdown is a fixed portal with z-index 9999. It is not clipped inside tables (elementFromPoint at the list bottom hits the list in BOQ and Bill) and closes on blur. Mobile 390px: CRM pages have no horizontal overflow and the list fits (x=10, w=370). Issues found are listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: No fallback logo. getLogo() is localStorage-only and the server /api/logo is currently '' (empty), so the RA bill prints WITHOUT any logo. The user explicitly asked for the logo. Every other print in the app (woPrint.js, Header.jsx, ReportsHub, HR letters) uses `getLogo() || "/arun-logo.jpg"`. Fix: `const logo = getLogo() || "/arun-logo.jpg";` (or an absolute `${window.location.origin}/arun-logo.jpg`). Verified: the relative path resolves in the popup and the image loads (naturalWidth 1006).

The popup HTML has no <!DOCTYPE html>, so it renders in quirks mode, where tables do not inherit body font-size. Body is 12px but all table cells (client/contract box, items, totals) render at 16px. The result is an oversized table vs a small header and footer, and long bills will spill onto more pages. Fix: prepend '<!DOCTYPE html>' and/or add 'table{font-size:inherit}' or 'td,th{font-size:12px}'.

The dropdown always opens below the input (top = rect.bottom + 2) and never flips up. When the input is near the bottom of the viewport (e.g. the first Contract item row at 1920x1080 sits at y≈818, right above the fixed CRM action bar), the 280px list goes off-screen and options cannot be clicked. Playwright reported 'element is outside of the viewport'. Fix: if window.innerHeight - rect.bottom < 280, open upward (top = rect.top - listHeight) or clamp maxHeight to the available space.

Position is computed only on focus/change. When the page scrolls while the list is open, the list stays at the old fixed coordinates, detached from the input. Mobile repro: the input moved from y 407 to 257 but the list stayed at 439. Fix: close on scroll/resize (window.addEventListener('scroll', close, true)) or recompute the position.

onBlur sets setTimeout(close, 180) without storing or clearing it. If the user re-focuses the same input within 180ms, the list opens and is then closed by the stale timer. Fix: keep the timer in a ref and clearTimeout it in show().

After picking an option, focus stays in the input (mousedown preventDefault). Clicking the input again does not reopen the list because onFocus does not fire. The user must type or blur and refocus. Add onClick={show}.

searchHsn is limited to 10 results with no 'more…' hint. Typing '9954' shows only 995411 to 995422, so common codes like 995444 (RCC) and 995473 (painting) cannot be found unless the user types more digits or a keyword. Consider limit 20-25 or a 'type more to narrow' footer. There is also no keyboard (arrow/enter) navigation.

issues: document scrollWidth is 1139 (horizontal overflow). This is likely pre-existing layout (wide fixed container), not caused by HsnInput.
The HSN cell is narrow (about 100px), so the placeholder 'HSN/SAC or item…' is truncated to 'HSN/SAC or iten'.

action_items: RABills.jsx printRA: use `getLogo() || "/arun-logo.jpg"` so the RA bill always prints with the logo (HIGH, the user's explicit ask).
RABills.jsx printRA: add <!DOCTYPE html> (or table{font-size:inherit}) so table text is 12px, not 16px.

HsnInput.jsx: flip the dropdown upward or clamp maxHeight when there is not enough space below. Currently it is unusable for inputs near the bottom of the viewport, e.g. the first contract item row at 1080p.
HsnInput.jsx: close or reposition the list on window scroll/resize, clear the blur timeout in show(), and add onClick={show} so it reopens on click.
Optional: raise the searchHsn limit (10 hides 995444/995473 for the query '9954') and add keyboard navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: BOQ/WO onPick calls setItem twice (hsn then description). This is safe because setItem uses a functional setBoq/setWo updater. Verified: both hsn and description were set.
ChangeOrders onPick uses setF({...f, ...}) with a closure over f. This is fine for a single click, but for consistency use the functional updater like Contracts does.
Contracts onPick overwrites gstPct even if the user had manually set it. This is acceptable (GST % is shown as indicative) but worth a note.
Company details and the logo come only from localStorage (getCompany/getLogo). On a fresh device before sync, the RA print uses DEFAULT_COMPANY with empty GSTIN/PAN/bank.

BOQ saved via the UI has boqNo '' (only a TEMP number is shown), so the WO 'BOQ Reference' option shows ' · TEST_BOQ33 Site' and 'BOQ Ref No' shows '—'. This looks pre-existing until approval, but the label is unclear.

success_rate.frontend: ~80%. Core pick/persist flows pass. RA print is missing the logo fallback. Dropdown has viewport-edge and scroll issues. WO and Bill save were not verifiable (0 vendors).

Use viewport 1920x1800 to avoid the HsnInput bottom-of-viewport issue when testing other flows (or verify the flip fix at 1920x1080 on the first Contract item row). Wait ≥200ms between blur and refocus of an HsnInput (stale blur timer). The RA print popup can be captured via context.expect_page(); check `.hdr img` and getComputedStyle(td).fontSize.
